text:
Maria Chen: quick experiment to surface fairness between mini-replay and synthetic interleaved bursts. Trying to reproduce continuous-batching starvation when tenants have mismatched sequence lengths + KV warmup. sharing config + first-pass numbers.

Ajay Patel: can you pin the model+quant and kernel set? that changed last week, might be the regression.

Maria Chen: yep pinned to redwood/rw1-7b:v2 + int4-fast kernels. config below. also using replay harness with shuffled-start timestamps to simulate concurrency.

runtime-bot: started replay harness 1799991123 on runner-07

Maria Chen:
```json
{
  "harness": "mini-replay",
  "tenants": 12,
  "workloads": ["chat-short", "chat-medium", "chat-long"],
  "seeds": 42,
  "max_delay_ms": 12,
  "batch_cap": 64,
  "pin_model": "redwood/rw1-7b:v2",
  "kernel_profile": "int4-fast"
}
```

Samir "Sam" Lopez: quick summary from the first run: p50=23ms p95=118ms p99=280ms overall qlen avg=3.2 but tenant skew is nasty. long-chat tenants show average batch sizes 2.1 while short-chat get 6.8.

Samir "Sam" Lopez: KV cache hit ramp also different: warmup latency for long-chat tenants spiked ~3x at start. includes a tiny snippet of logs:
```
2026-02-15T14:12:09.123Z [runner-07] tenant=tenant-9 kernel=int4-fast batch_size=2 latency=124ms kv_cache_miss
2026-02-15T14:12:09.456Z [runner-07] tenant=tenant-3 kernel=int4-fast batch_size=7 latency=32ms kv_cache_hit
```

Ajay Patel: looks like kernel selection + batch cap interplay. when kernel falls back or swaps, delay budget increases and small-batch tenants get postponed. did you try lowering max_delay_ms?

Maria Chen: tried max_delay_ms=4 and batch_cap=32 in a follow-up: p95 improved for long-chat tenants (~95ms) but throughput dropped 8% and small-tenant latency rose slightly. tradeoff.

deploy-bot: canary rollout of int4-fast -> int4-stable blocked due to p99 regression on tenant group B

Ajay Patel: I suspect scheduling priority logic is honoring batchable size heuristics but not accounting for per-tenant sequence length distribution. proposed quick fix: add tenant-weighted delay cap override so small tenants get an earlier flush when they've been waiting > X.

Maria Chen: proposed AB plan: 1) baseline reproduce with mini-replay seeded runs (10 reps) 2) synthetic interleaved bursts (deterministic timing) 3) kernel swap ab-test (int4-fast vs int4-stable) 4) tenant-weight override enabled/disabled. collect p50/p95/p99, batch_size_hist, kv_miss_rate per-tenant.

Samir "Sam" Lopez: I'll run the synthetic interleaved bursts and dump batch hist + kv-heatmap. ETA 2hrs.

Maria Chen: thanks. put results in /confluence/perf/replays/mini-interleave-1799991123 and ping here. tagging @Ajay for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: ack. will review kernel traces and scheduler logs (trace ids: t-1799991123-1 .. t-1799991123-6)
